---
title: "Writing pages"
---

This page shows each element that the template styles.
Copy the element that you need and change its text.

## Callouts

::: {.callout-note}

## A note

Use a note for extra information.

:::

::: {.callout-tip}

## A tip

Use a tip for advice that saves time.

:::

::: {.callout-warning}

## A warning

Use a warning for an action that can cause a problem.

:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}

## A collapsed callout

The reader opens this callout to read more.

:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}

A minimal callout has no title bar.

:::

## Code

A code block can show a file name.

```{.python filename="hello.py"}
def greet(name):
    return f"Hello, {name}"
```

A code block can number its lines.

```{.python code-line-numbers="true"}
first = 1
second = 2
total = first + second
```

A terminal block shows a command and its output.
A line that starts with `$` and a space is a command.

```{.bash .terminal}
$ echo "Hello"
Hello
```

## Tabs

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Python

```python
print("Hello")
```

## R

```r
cat("Hello\n")
```

:::
